hook: Free, fully offline dictation now lives in your iPhone keyboard.

beats.say: Hex is now on the iOS App Store: a keyboard you can talk to. Tap the Hex key in any app and your words land where you're typing.
Speech is turned into text on the iPhone itself, with no account, no subscription and no cloud, and it works offline once a language model downloads.
It also cleans up ums and corrections, supports spoken punctuation, and offers styles like Polished, Casual, Notes and Verbatim.
